description: Hello #TeamCastro! We are T-27 days until Election Day! Senate District 37 had a very special guest this weekend! Senator Jon Ossoff joined #TeamCastro and local Cobb candidates for a canvass launch on Saturday. The energy in the room was infectious. Together, we knocked 400 doors in just two hours! I hope you will help us keep the momentum going into early voting and join us for a canvassing or phone banking shift. We need all hands on deck! Reminder: Make your plan to vote today! You can check your registration, view your ballot and find your polling location here! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
